items.formula: GPA = SUM(credits_i * gradePoint_i) / SUM(credits_i), over modules that count toward GPA
items.implementation_note: Grade points are held as integer tenths and credits as integers so the weighted sum is exact; only the final division is rounded.

items.note: Public SLIIT descriptions report GPA to two decimals; the official tie-breaking rule was not found. HALF_UP is a documented research assumption.
A module counted toward GPA with zero credits is invalid input; it is never silently skipped.
A grade that is not in the accepted policy produces REVIEW_REQUIRED and no GPA value. C3 never guesses a grade point.
Modules explicitly flagged countsTowardGpa=false (e.g. pass/fail modules) are excluded from both sums. If no module counts, the result is REVIEW_REQUIRED (NO_GPA_CREDITS).
The accepted policy does not define how repeated attempts of the same module are combined, so a repeated module code produces REVIEW_REQUIRED instead of a guessed value.
